Not really. Sites have limited landing and takeoff spots—usually just a few. If too many drones try to leave or land at once, they’ll block each other. So dispatchers have to plan carefully, sometimes waiting for a drone to finish its job before sending another one out from the same spot.

For example, at a busy hospital site, if three drones are already taking off or landing, the fourth one might have to wait or go to a different nearby site if possible. It’s all about keeping things smooth and avoiding collisions on the ground.
